name: marketing-product-cards
title: Product Cards
description: Product card components built with Tailwind CSS. These responsive, SEO-friendly cards are perfect for showcasing products in eCommerce stores, landing pages, and marketing sites. Easily customizable for any brand or catalog.
useWhen: Showing products in a collection, search result, recommendation rail, or category grid.
Giving shoppers a compact route to inspect a product, choose a variant, or add an item to a cart.
avoidWhen: Displaying detailed specifications or reviews — use a product detail page.
The collection has no consistent image aspect ratio or pricing information.
responsiveBehavior: Card grids reduce their column count as space narrows. Images preserve their intended aspect ratio, while actions remain visible and large enough for touch input.
accessibility: Product images need useful alt text unless the product title already provides the equivalent description.
Every icon-only wishlist or quick-action control needs an accessible name.
Use a single clear product link instead of nested interactive controls.
